refusal_audit.summary: 0 admitted errors; 4 refusals lost a true single-step reaction to the admission span parser's sentence shapes (rows 2, 3, 4, 8), 1 to a stitched model quote; the rest were right to refuse

why_so_few: Europe PMC timed out: all 3 searches of the Listeria run (ReadTimeout), and 7 of 9 open-access full texts (not cached = the request raised; fetch_full_text swallowed it; now recorded as full_text_errors)
abstracts rarely state a single reaction: 13 papers read as abstract only (no full text) gave 4 extractions, all refused correctly
the admission span parser reads 'X converts A to B' / 'A is converted to B by E' but not 'is first/further converted into', 'is oxidized to ... by', 'are condensed into ..., catalyzed by'
max_papers=5 in query order: 52 further candidates were dropped as over_max_papers
live2 (round-1 code records full-text errors): 7 of 13 open-access full texts failed (HTTPError 2, ReadTimeout 5); the searches all answered this time (Listeria 8/6/10 hits)
